note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 at HEAD 635aa08b78 (independent judge, clean clone). Section 4.4.1: "Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it." dc7de8e76f and 000e6fdfea changed the two cited units releaseSPD and warnSPDLeft, and nothing else this verdict cites. releaseSPD's only change is the call warnSPDLeft(log) becoming warnSPDLeft(dp, log). warnSPDLeft now names each leftover through spdLeft.describe(dp), which copies the ledger out under l.mu and asks policyDeleteCommand (inner_selectors.go) for each entry's removal command: dataplane.XFRMPolicyDeleteCommand for xfrmBackend, the recorded spdEntries entry for vppBackend (vppPolicyDelCommand), and a plain text naming the selector when the backend names none or a nil dataplane is passed. policyDeleteCommand always returns a string, so describe still returns exactly one name per ledger entry, and warnSPDLeft still returns true exactly when the ledger holds an entry: the decision to keep the catch-all is unchanged, only the text of the warning is. Probe in the clone (go -overlay, tree untouched): warnSPDLeft made to return false always, and describe made to return no name, each turn TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, TestChildInstallRollbackFailureIsRecordedInTheSPDLedger, TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheExactRemovalCommand and TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheBackendCommand red. The three tagged units are byte-identical to the recorded ones (TestRFC4301DefaultFinalSPDEntryDiscards, TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry, TestRFC4301InboundClearPacketIsDiscardedByTheDefaultFinalEntry) and still assert the catch-all's existence, rank and discard. Observation, not a finding: the keep-the-catch-all-at-exit behaviour that these two units carry is proven by the untagged TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, not by a tagged unit. Scope note carried from RFC4301-5.2-1: VPP holds no catch-all and the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 entries have none. Verdict stands.
